caption: Here are some of the best AI tools you should check out this year! Let me know what you think in the comments.

retentionDrops.name: Drop 1: intro, 0-3 s
retentionDrops.diagnosis: Slow opening buildup before value deliverable is shown.
retentionDrops.fix: Trim weak introductory greeting; flash the final output in the first 0.8s.

retentionDrops.name: Drop 2: pacing, 20-30 s
retentionDrops.diagnosis: Monotone pacing with static screen capture and no visual pattern shift.
retentionDrops.fix: Add zoom-ins, SFX whoosh, kinetic subtitles, or B-roll every 3-4 seconds.

aiSummary: Your video has strong viral potential, but the first 4 seconds can be improved.

hookComparison.original: Today I am going to tell you about some artificial intelligence tools that might help you in your workflow...
hookComparison.improved: 5 AI tools that do my job in 10 seconds...
auditFindings: Original opened with passive greeting ('Today I am going to...') which loses 35% of mobile viewers.
Rewritten version uses concrete number (5) and extreme contrast ('my job in 10 seconds').

findings.title: Intro is 4.2 s too long before main value reveal
findings.action: Trim intro to jump directly into tool #1 with an on-screen kinetic card.

findings.title: Opening can be stronger — high viewer drop risk in first 3s
findings.action: Use the high-curiosity hook rewrite: '5 AI tools that do my job in 10 seconds...'

findings.title: Thumbnail text readability low on 320px mobile screens
findings.action: Increase font size to 72pt and bump background contrast to at least 4.5:1.

findings.title: Moderate background room noise detected (SNR 18dB)
findings.action: Apply voice isolation or noise reduction filter to crisp up the vocal track.

findings.title: Topic has extremely high current trend velocity (+340% WoW)
findings.action: Capitalize on 'AI Workflow 2026' surge by publishing within peak window (5-8 PM).

findings.title: Strong emotional ending and natural conversation cadence
findings.action: Preserve the conversational call-to-action tone at the 0:42 mark.

platformFit.reason: 48s vertical format with tech tutorial topic aligns perfectly with current Shorts algorithm focus on informational retention.
High shareability and fast pacing, but requires punchier sound design and faster cut frequency (every 2.5s).
Visual polish is strong; recommended to emphasize aesthetic color grading and save-prompt CTA.
Aspect ratio (9:16) and short duration are poorly matched for standard landscape long-form viewers.

thumbnailSuggestion.composition: Large vibrant typography (yellow/white) on left 65%, shock/demonstration reaction frame on right 35%, subtle dark vignette.

editPlan.instruction: Trim first 3.2s greeting; begin on live screen recording of Tool #1 generating results.
Overlay bold kinetic subtitle captions (font: Montserrat/Inter ExtraBold, 64pt).
Insert whip-pan zoom transition to break monotone monologue pacing.
Run a 6dB speech isolator filter to eliminate background fan hum.
Add pinned comment reminder and visual pointing arrow towards the save button.
